info.name: AtoZSalon
info.shortIntro: Experience luxury hair styling, rejuvenating skin therapies, and bespoke bridal beauty crafted by certified master artists.
info.description: ABCD Salon is Mumbai's premier unisex destination for elevated haircare, skincare, and bespoke makeup artistry. Founded on principles of meticulous technique, genuine international products (L'Oréal, Kérastase, Dyson), and warm hospitality, we provide a relaxing sanctuary where your personal aesthetic comes alive.
info.address: Shop No. 12, Ground Floor, Royal Palms Avenue, Linking Road, Bandra West
info.heroSubheadline: Step into an oasis of contemporary elegance where master stylists sculpt perfection and revitalize your glow with premium international care.
info.announcementBanner: ✨ Festive Special: Flat 20% OFF on all Luxury Hair Spa & Skin Cleanup sessions this week! Use code FESTIVE20 on WhatsApp booking.
info.aboutTitle: A Decade of Hair & Skin Artistry
info.aboutStory: Founded with an obsession for precision and warmth, ABCD Salon brings together passionate stylists and clinical-grade dermatological skin treatments under one luxurious roof. We believe that true grooming is not just about looks—it is about restoring confidence, relieving stress, and celebrating individuality.
info.paymentNote: Pay directly via Google Pay, PhonePe, or Paytm with zero transaction fee.
